notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
[u][i][b]A really big update to the game:[/b][/i][/u]
[list]
[*] Demo version is now available for free play. It consists of 3 levels.
[*] A new environment for some levels: MODERN CITY. Feel yourself as you just play squash in city park at clear weekend day.
[*] New perk "Master of Slo-mo' was added to game. It allows you to collect and laucnh slo-mos at suitable moment.
[*] New bonus "Random Kill' which you can harvest from bright flying lights. It just does what expect of it: destroy 1 random brick in level.
[*] New textures for energy grid. Before there was a single texture. Now there are 4 different textures, which can be found in different levels.
[/list]

[b]New road map for 2023 for VRkanoid:[/b]
[list]
[*] Multuyplayer mode.
[*] Level editor.
[/list]

[b]And, as usual:[/b]
[list]
[*] Minor changes and improvements.
[*] Fixed a lot of bugs.
[*] Added new ones ;)
[/list]

[u][b]Enjoy![/b][/u]

notes.title: First update
notes.content:
I am glad to inform everybody who has bought my game, that i am still supporting it. I am planning to add some new features to the game in the future. And there are a list of some changes for today:

[list]
[*] Ball physics is changed. Bounciness koefficient was decreased. You will really feel it.
[*] Option to change player's floor level was added. It can be found in settings screen. With this option you can change gameplay style from ping-pong to squash / tennis.
[*] Requirements for achieving stars were changed for some levels. Generally it became more easy to achieve at least 1 star in level.
[*] Some bugs were fixed.
[/list]
